Generated. Do not edit. Made from the list of reports it links, so one added or removed appears here without a second file being edited.

The scenario

Source, not a rendering. These are the files themselves - a view of either would be one more thing that can drift from it.

  • ../scenario/commands/play.4x - the commands that ran, in order
  • ../scenario/expected/play.4x - what the scenario should produce, reviewed by hand

Reports

Generated. Every one is derived from the scenario or from the release, and regenerated rather than written. The page is the link; the markdown that made it is beside the name, because a change is reviewed as a diff and a diff of HTML is not one.

  • catalog - every kind, with everything the release says about it in one place (markdown)
  • commands - every command that ran, flattened out of its files, with the recipe it fired (markdown)
  • containment - what holds what, collapsible, with used against total on every container (no markdown - it is the collapsing that makes it readable)
  • entities - the same state as entities and their components (markdown)
  • recipes - every recipe, with its own lines gathered under it and a worked example beside (markdown)
  • recipes - every recipe, with its own lines gathered under it and a worked example beside (markdown)
  • state - the state after the scenario, one table per relation (markdown)
  • turns - every turn: the commands that ran, what changed, and what was there (markdown)
